vscode-systemd.commands.reportIssue: Report an issue with the systemd extension...
vscode-systemd.commands.plot: Plot a diagram detailing which system services have been started at what time.
vscode-systemd.config.units.label: Controls which system unit property is shown as the label in the Units explorer.
vscode-systemd.config.units.description: Controls which system unit properties are shown as the description below the label in the Units explorer.
vscode-systemd.config.units.icon: Controls which system unit property determines the icon shown in the Units explorer.
vscode-systemd.config.units.groupBy: Controls how system units are grouped in the Units explorer.
vscode-systemd.config.units.sortBy: Controls how system units are sorted within each group in the Units explorer.
